summary: This Form 8-K filed by RCI HOSPITALITY HOLDINGS, INC. reports that Nasdaq notified the company on May 8, 2026 that it has regained compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) after filing its delayed quarterly report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended December 31, 2025. The Nasdaq staff previously notified the company of non-compliance on January 30, 2026 and February 18, 2026 due to late periodic filings. This filing is a routine notification of regained listing compliance, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisory roles are mentioned. The matter is now closed with Nasdaq, and no further action is required.
